primitives.note: H-28G Evolution Turret / H-28Q Apex Turret is a deployed pet that independently attacks a nearby target with its own rapid-fire hit and a separately-charging beam hit; its damage stacks scale off Heimerdinger's current AP/level continuously.
Turret Kit charges (max 3, 1 kit per cast, ~20s recharge modified by ability haste) gate how many turrets Heimerdinger can deploy/redeploy inside the 15s window.

W fires 5 separately-resolved rocket hits per cast (initial + 4 lesser-damage subsequent hits on the same target), or 4 waves of 5 (20 hits, tiered lesser-damage) once upgraded by R; E's R-upgraded Lightning Grenade bounces 3 times but only damages a champion once per cast.

R (UPGRADE!!!, 3 ranks) permanently transforms one basic ability per rank into an evolved form (Apex Turret / Rocket Swarm / Lightning Grenade) with different damage numbers and mechanics; which abilities are evolved depends on player choice and R rank.
Mana costs (Q 20 + a kit, W 50-90, E 85, R 100 on toggle) constrain how many casts fit in the 15s fight; empowered (R-upgraded) casts are free of mana cost.

needsBespoke.why: The turret (Q) is a persistent pet with two independent, differently-scaling attack types (basic rapid-fire and a beam that charges up over time and receives partial/full charge grants from W and E landing on champions), up to three turrets can be alive at once, and a turret-kit ammo economy governs redeployment; the R-upgraded Apex Turret additionally expires after a fixed 8s and must be refreshed. None of this (a multi-instance pet with an internal charge-meter fed by sibling abilities) is captured by a single primitive; it needs bespoke turret-state simulation layered on top of pet-or-summon and weapon-or-ammo-system.

unsettled.question: For the 15s damage fight, is Heimerdinger assumed to have already spent his R charges to permanently upgrade Q/W/E before the fight starts (so Apex Turret/Rocket Swarm/Lightning Grenade are active from t=0), or must R be cast during the fight window to unlock each upgrade (costing an action, 100 mana, and the ~3s recast delay)?
options: R upgrades are pre-applied as a fight-opening state (all evolved forms available immediately)
R must be toggled and consumed in-fight before an evolved ability can be cast, spending time/mana in the 15s window
quotes: These empowered abilities have the same {{sti|cooldowns}} as their basic forms, deal modified damage, and do not have a {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.
'''Heimerdinger''' deploys a ''H-28Q Apex Turret'' at the target location, which lasts for 8 seconds.

unsettled.question: How fast does the turret's beam attack charge up 'over time' on its own (absent bonus charge from W/E landing on a champion)? Neither the bin (unresolved calc parts f0517331 / 8109ae7b) nor the wiki states a numeric base charge rate, which determines how often the turret's much-higher-damage beam fires versus its regular rapid-fire hits during the fight.
options: Beam charges on a fixed per-second timer independent of W/E procs
Beam only ever charges from W/E hits landing on the dummy (20%/hit from W, 100% from E)
Beam charges from both a base passive rate and bonus grants from W/E
quotes: a secondary beam attack that charges up over time, which deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit

unsettled.question: What is the turret's own basic (rapid-fire) attack interval/attack speed? Neither source gives an explicit attack-speed or cooldown value for the turret's regular shot, only its per-hit damage.
options: Assume a canonical historical value from prior patch data outside these sources
Treat the turret as firing at a fixed simulator-assumed rate (e.g. 1 attack/sec) absent better data
quotes: The ''H-28G Evolution Turret's'' stats update every second to reflect rank ups, level ups, and changes in '''Heimerdinger's''' ability power.

proposal: Assume R is already at rank 3 with Q, W, and E all pre-upgraded (Apex Turret, Rocket Swarm, Lightning Grenade active) before the 15s fight begins.
Opening: deploy all 3 available turret kits as Apex Turrets adjacent to the dummy (3x Q) to start their beam-charge and rapid-fire damage immediately.

Immediately follow with W (Rocket Swarm, 4 waves of 5 rockets) and then E (Lightning Grenade) on the dummy to grant the turrets beam charge (20% per rocket hit, full charge from the grenade) and add burst magic damage.
Recast W and E on cooldown for the rest of the fight (W 7-11s depending on rank, E 11s), each cast also topping up turret beam charge.
Recast Q whenever a turret kit charge is available and/or an Apex Turret is about to expire at its 8s duration, to keep 3 turrets active as continuously as possible.
Do not use any mobility, CC, or vision effects; treat the passive movement speed bonus as irrelevant to the stationary dummy fight.
questions: Should basic attacks be woven in as filler damage even though no auto-attack data is given in these sources, or is Heimerdinger assumed to never auto-attack in this fight?

Given only 3 R ranks total, which of Q/W/E should be assumed upgraded if the fight is simulated at a level below 16-18 (i.e., R not yet maxed) — is a partial-upgrade state (e.g. only Q and W upgraded) the intended assumption at lower levels?

Should all 3 turret kit charges be spent immediately on 3 turrets, or should one be held in reserve to redeploy a fresh Apex Turret exactly as an earlier one's 8s duration expires, to maximize turret uptime over the 15s window?
Does turret beam damage from multiple simultaneously active turrets stack (i.e., do 3 turrets each independently charge and fire beams), multiplying the ambiguous per-turret beam charge rate by 3?
